text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Under the Overdraft Policy v3, Harbor can charge you a maximum of 3 overdraft fees in a single business day. Each item paid through Courtesy Pay is charged $29 per item, up to a maximum of three items per business day. Additionally, if you use Overdraft Transfer Protection, there is one transfer fee of $5.00 per business day regardless of how many transfers occur. So in total, you could be charged up to $87 in overdraft fees (3 × $29) plus $5 for Overdraft Transfer Protection in a single business day.", "cited_chunk_ids": ["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004"], "reason": "The Overdraft Policy v3 explicitly states the per-item fee limit of three items per business day and the Overdraft Transfer Protection fee cap of once per business day."}
